title: The Forge Sings
text: The smith says the iron hums as it cools, a low sweet note like a woman singing far away, and it will not stop. He has not slept in days. He stands at the anvil with his eyes shut, lips moving. The blades he makes now are very fine.

options.label: Let the smith follow the song, and see what it makes of him.

outcomes.text: What comes off the anvil is beautiful and wrong. The smith weeps to see it.
The smith hammers for three days and nights and remembers none of it. The iron is gone, and so is the song.

options.label: Quench the forge for a season before the song takes him entirely.

outcomes.text: The humming stops. The smith sleeps for two days and wakes asking where she went.
